svg.title: Solstice Analytics: Labs 01 to 05 as one environment
svg.desc: One Azure subscription containing everything built in Labs 01 to 05. Internet clients reach the Standard load balancer and scale set in the prod VNet, and an App Service admin tool. A container batch job in the prod VNet reads and writes the RA-GZRS storage account through a private endpoint. A hub VNet holds an ops VM and is peered to prod and dev, which are not peered to each other. NAT gateways give prod compute and the hub outbound access. Storage logs and ops VM performance data flow to Log Analytics, alert rules notify an action group by email, and the ops VM is backed up to a Recovery Services vault. Lab 01 policies, role assignments and a resource lock govern the resource groups.
svg.text: Solstice Analytics: Labs 01 to 05 as one environment
Everything built across the five labs, in one Azure subscription, with every connection drawn. Numbered arrows are the traffic flows; the key at the bottom right explains each one.
Same definition assigned by Labs 01, 02, 03 and 05
Resources without the tag are refused
East US and East US 2 only
Applied to all five resource groups
so each later lab inherits the same rules
closed until an NSG allows traffic
the PaaS comparison, no VNet link
no public IP · reached by SSH key
Test point for the private endpoint,
scale set SSH and the backup target
It is peered to prod and dev but
Default outbound access is off and there is no NAT gateway,
so dev has no internet egress. Throwaway test VMs only.
Prod and dev are NOT peered. Peering is not transitive,
so the hub does not pass traffic between them.
Dev has no NAT gateway and default outbound is off.
Activity log: any resource lock deleted (protects Lab 01)
email receiver: primary-oncall, one group serves all three rules
RA-GZRS · TLS 1.2 · public network access off after lock-down
Client Success reads (RBAC), the batch job writes
Reached only through the private endpoint once locked down
private DNS zone · rg-solstice-data · registration off
StorageBlobLogs from the blob service diagnostic setting
Perf from the Azure Monitor Agent and dcr-solstice-ops-perf
Saved KQL: storage errors, and ops-VM CPU against storage errors
Policy policy-daily-30day: daily at 23:00, keep 30 days
Protects vm-solstice-ops, the one stateful VM
Scale-set instances are rebuilt from the model, so they are not backed up
Locally redundant · rg-solstice-monitoring · backup job and recovery point verified
HOW TO READ THE NUMBERED FLOWS
Inbound: clients reach the load balancer and scale set, and the admin tool
Batch job: image from ACR, then the private endpoint to storage
Ops VM reaches the scale set (SSH) and the private endpoint (443)
Outbound: NAT gateways give prod compute and the hub a static IP
Telemetry: blob logs and ops VM CPU and memory into Log Analytics
Backup: the ops VM is protected in the Recovery Services vault
Access: sg-client-success can read the processed container
A, B and C alert rules all notify the on-call action group
rg-solstice-core (L01) · rg-solstice-data (L02) · rg-solstice-network (L02, L04) · rg-solstice-compute (L03) · rg-solstice-monitoring (L05). Names with {suffix} use the name_suffix variable.
Prod and dev are deliberately not connected. Everything else in the subscription connects through the paths drawn above.
